artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The tab shell: TabNavigation + useTabNavigation (imported, unedited; analyticsGroup 'investor-reporting'), tabs reporting/analysis/holdings in that order. Each tab's body is StatusPanel bound to one selection-store slice (performance/analysis/holdings). On mount and on every firm/scope change it calls store.switchScope then issues the three read operations (getPerformanceReport, listAnalysisRequests, getHoldingsSnapshot) through the SAME api instance index.tsx already created, deriving each slice's envelope from that response's own Availability via envelopeFromAvailability; a rejected request applies REQUEST_FAILED_ENVELOPE. Bootstrap placeholders (BOOTSTRAP_SEGMENT='bootstrap', BOOTSTRAP_DATE='1970-01-01') are used before a real scope resolves, mirroring index.tsx's own BOOTSTRAP_SEGMENT pattern. TO-FE-s-3 does not name tabs/reporting/, tabs/analysis/ or tabs/holdings/ in this order's <paths> -- those are later cells -- so all three bodies are inline here, not in subfolders.

The status renderer every tab uses: state -> label (via state/status.ts), sourceAsOf -> source age text, safeActions -> one button per action, publicReasonCode -> plain text. White panel on the silver canvas; buttons are solid indigo with white text (never a light control directly on silver).

The selection store, no React: Selection={firm,scope,revision}; PROTECTED_SLICES=[performance,analysis,holdings,narrative,export]; applyResponse gates on (scope,revision) captured at request time, dropping a mismatch into droppedLate and touching nothing else; switchScope clears every slice to EMPTY_ENVELOPE synchronously before the caller can issue its next fetch.

The pure status mapping: ENVELOPE_STATE_LABELS (nine states, nine distinct labels), isCompleteState (reuses the contract's own NON_ASSERTABLE_STATES so PARTIAL never reads as complete; READY and STALE are the two states a complete-report path may render through, per that same denominator), winsOverCachedReady (STALE or an over-age source wins over a cached READY), defaultSafeActions, envelopeFromAvailability, and formatSourceAge -- the ONLY function in this cell that reads Date.now.
Binds the store to React via useSyncExternalStore (useSelectionStore creates one instance per component lifetime; useSelection/useSlice/useDroppedLate subscribe).
